facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for my best friend's birthday.
My best friend loves to read.
My best friend loves to travel.
I like the personalized book club subscription idea.
I like the literary walking tour idea.
I recently got my brother a photography book for $50.
My brother loved the photography book.
I spent around $80 on a silver necklace for my sister's birthday three weeks ago.
I am considering combining the two gifts (book club subscription and literary walking tour).
My friend loves reading about different cultures and traveling.
For the literary walking tour, I was thinking of Paris.
I think a private guide would be a good idea for the literary walking tour.
I want the literary walking tour to include a stop at a charming café or bistro.
I think a souvenir book or journal would be a nice touch for the gift.
I want help with the logistics of booking the tour and the book club subscription.
I am considering including a personalized message with the gift.
I am thinking of getting a gift basket with French-themed items.
The French-themed items I am considering include macarons.
The French-themed items I am considering include a French novel.
I am considering including a few other French-themed things in the gift basket.
I want to include the book club subscription and literary walking tour as a surprise element.
I would include a voucher or gift certificate for my friend to redeem instead of booking the tour or subscription directly.
